description:
The travel agency has terminated partnerships with three hotel chains. Delete the following three hotel vertices from the Hotels class in the demodb database:

1. Copacabana Palace (Rio de Janeiro, Brazil)
2. Park Hyatt Tokyo (Tokyo, Japan)
3. Four Seasons Sydney (Sydney, Australia)

Use DELETE VERTEX (not DELETE FROM) to ensure all connected edges are also properly removed. You can execute these commands via OrientDB Studio's Browse/Query page.

Example command: DELETE VERTEX FROM Hotels WHERE Name = 'Copacabana Palace'

After deletion, verify that querying for these hotels returns zero results.

OrientDB Studio is available at http://localhost:2480/studio/index.html
Server credentials: root / GymAnything123!
Database: demodb (user: admin / password: admin)
